{"answer":"Based on my search of the context filesystem, I found the answer in the KIP-1285 documentation.

The final name of the enum type introduced in KIP-1285 to replace the `isTimestamped` and `isHeadersEnabled` boolean parameters is **`DslStoreType`**.

According to the document `/store/discussions/kip-1285-dsl-header-aware-stores.md` (dated around February 20, 2026), the enum was proposed by Matthias J. Sax with two values:
- `DEFAULT` (equivalent to isTimestamped=true, isHeadersEnabled=false)
- `HEADERS` (equivalent to isTimestamped=true, isHeadersEnabled=true)

This enum is used in the new constructor signature for DSL classes like `DslKeyValueParams`, replacing the old boolean parameters approach with a cleaner enum-based design.
